name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 4 visits over 62 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2026-05-25, at wavelengths from 1.35 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
